title: Rung 0: the share of new hidden test cases with an ancestor among existing tests is measured on 200 PRs
body:
Why: the hidden-test mechanism research (.krn/runs/hidden-test-mechanism-research/report.md, 2026-11-13) ranks sibling-test transplant first: a blind agent ports the human test cases of the nearest existing sibling (command, handler, parser) to the new entity and the port gates Stop. Rung 0 decides whether the premise holds before any build, with no model calls.
Outcome: 200 merged PRs that add tests, 50 each from 4 public repositories (2 TypeScript, 2 Python, cloned under .krn/sources); for every added test case, the nearest pre-existing test case in the parent tree by a clone detector, with a threshold fixed before looking at results; the share with an ancestor, split by new feature vs fix and by language, with its 95% interval (about ±7 pp).
Kill criterion: share with an ancestor below 30% drops the sibling transplant line; otherwise rung 1 (precision on gold patches vs issue-only tests) becomes a task.
Cost: under $5, no model sessions. Record: .krn/runs/sibling-transplant/rung0.md with the commands and counts.
